questions.q: The shortcut key Shift+Ctrl+$ can be used for the _____ number format.
To reveal hidden columns, first _____, then choose Home, Format, Hide and Unhide, and then Unhide columns.
o: Select the cell to the left of the column you want to unhide.
Select cells that span the hidden columns.
Select the cells to the right of the column you want to unhide.
Delete columns that span the hidden columns.
Insert cells that span the hidden columns.

questions.q: To change one or more column width, one should select the cells in columns that need to be changed, choose Home, Format and select the _____ option from the list that appears to fit the column width to the widest cell contents in the selection.
To hide selected columns using the keyboard, select Home, Format, _____, and then Hide.

Which of these is/are valid vertical alignment option(s)?
I. Right II. Center across selection III. Center IV. Top V. Justify
questions.e: Right and Center-across-selection are horizontal alignment options; Top/Center/Justify are the valid vertical options here.

questions.q: To copy the format of a range of cells to more than one range _____.
o: Double click the format painter button

questions.q: Which of the following is the spreadsheet application used in Windows Operating Systems
The number of characters that can be typed in a cell is limited to
The following are examples of spreadsheet applications except
questions.e: MS Outlook is an email/calendar client, not a spreadsheet application.

questions.q: The shortcut keys for formatting a time in the default format is
In inserting a cell, which of the following options is not displayed in the insert dialog box?
questions.e: The Insert dialog offers Shift cells right, Shift cells down, Entire row, and Entire column — not "Shift cells left".

questions.q: By pressing the _____ key, one can edit the contents of a cell.
What are the shortcut keys for entering the current date in a cell?
Which of the following keys can remove a selected character?
Which of the following is NOT a use of spreadsheet applications in the accounting field?
questions.e: Regression coefficients are a statistical-analysis task, not a routine accounting use of a spreadsheet.

questions.q:
The steps in opening a new excel document are
I. Microsoft excel II. All programs III. Start IV. Microsoft office
questions.e: Start → All Programs → Microsoft Office → Microsoft Excel.

questions.q: A number is accepted as a text if it is preceded by
questions.e: A leading apostrophe (') forces Excel to treat a numeric entry as text.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT accepted in representing numbers?
questions.e: Numbers may include digits, E (scientific notation), decimal points, + and -, but not an asterisk.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
questions.e: Ctrl+R fills right, it does not mean "Read".

questions.q: A _____ is a grid with labelled columns and rows.
Microsoft Excel is example of _____
Which of the following is NOT the correct method of editing cell content?
What is the default display format of dates in excel
Valid date entries are aligned to the
questions.e: Excel recognises valid dates as numbers internally, so like all numbers they are right-aligned by default.

questions.q: If the value 2 is entered in a cell A1 and the auto fill handle is dragged over cells A2 to A4, what values are displayed in cells A2 to A4?
questions.e: Dragging the fill handle on a single plain number copies that same value, it doesn't create a series.

questions.q: Sorting cannot be done using more than one column.
questions.e: Excel supports multi-level sorting (sort by several columns/keys at once).

questions.q: When a table is filtered, the rows that do not match the filtered criteria are permanently removed from the table.
questions.e: Filtering only hides non-matching rows; it doesn't delete them.

questions.q: Filters can be applied to more than one column in a table.
When a large worksheet is to take up more than one printed page, Page Setup options can be set to make row and column headings appear on each printed page.
questions.e: This is done via Page Setup → Sheet → Print Titles.

questions.q: Row and column headings that are set to print on each printed page, do NOT appear on each page in Print Preview.
questions.e: Print Preview shows exactly what will print, including repeated print titles on every page.

questions.q: Each data series in a chart is represented by a unique _____.
The horizontal axis is also known as the _____ axis.
To provide additional information in a chart, you can insert a(n) _____.
The _____ form the boundaries of a chart and contains the scale against which data plots.
A single piece of data such as sales for one year is known as:

_____ is the process of arranging data in numerical or alphabetical order (ascending or descending)
_____ are miniature images of the presentation slides.
Using _____ enables the user to select a group of non-continuous slides.
Bullet _____ are individual lines of bullet text on a slide.
A slide's _____ is the arrangement of the text and graphic elements or placeholders on that slide.
_____ is NOT a slide layout.
Which view allows you to apply formatting to multiple slides?
What is common to the Excel functions TODAY, NOW and PI?
o: They belong to the same category of functions
They all take the same number of arguments
They take different number of arguments

questions.q: The functions AND, OR and NOT belongs to what category of functions?

Given that the years 1800 and 1900 are not leap years, what date has the serial number 777?
Which of the following functions can be used to obtain the factorial of a given number?
What value will be returned by the expression =even(0.0000001)?
questions.e: EVEN() rounds a positive number up to the next even integer, so any value above 0 rounds up to 2.
